profile: F_prof(phi) = sum_g min_{lambda_g in box} F_g(phi, lambda_g)
equality: The constrained global minimum of F equals the minimum of F_prof if and only if every inner minimization is the exact constrained minimum on its own box.

native_bounds.nfw_c_of_M: c=10*(M200/1e12)^(-0.1), fixed, not a free parameter

envelope: Where the local minimizer is unique and the active set is constant, dF_prof/dphi equals the sum of partial derivatives holding lambda_g at that minimizer.
nondifferentiable_when: a local parameter enters or leaves a bound
the inner argmin is not unique
